description: Soft-delete a billing project and its whole task/subtask hierarchy into the recycle bin, where an admin can restore it. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

project_id.description: Id of the project to delete.

name: delete_project
